newsitem.title: USA: Santander picks director Avila's successor.
newsitem.headline: Santander picks director Avila's successor.

text.p: Santander Investment said on Friday that Managing Director Jose Antonio Diaz has been named head of Santander Investment's New York office, effective immediately.
Diaz replaces Joaquin Avila, whose resignation was announced on Thursday. The company said Avila was leaving by mutual agreement.

Diaz joined Santander in 1992 as the head of corporate finance for Latin America in Madrid. He will oversee Santander Financial Products and the fixed income business of the New York office, the company said.
Santander Investment is a subsidary of Spain's Banco Santander SA.
